```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "TX",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx, aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf(linewidth = 0.1, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    option = "viridis"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County in Texas (2020)",
    caption = "Source: US Census Bureau, 2016–2020 ACS 5-year estimates",
    fill = "Median Household\nIncome"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
